numerical_remediation.method: Retain project-reported equation-derived MSISE/CubicSpline replacements with normalized-evaluation regression repairs; restore NASA Brent solver structure with focused safeguards. NotAKnot changes are comments only.
numerical_remediation.authorship_limitation: Independent-origin/non-copying descriptions are project assertions. This source/behavior review does not independently authenticate authorship, source exposure, a clean-room process or rights clearance.

historical_validation.summary: Prior spline/atmosphere checks retained: 640 MSISE spline datasets/40722 evaluations, 5400 atmosphere cases (density change <=7.333e-7 relative), 320 C++ datasets/3200 evaluations. New Brent: 966 cases, every proposal bracket-contained, SciPy/analytic comparisons, seven invalid-input cases, copy/assignment/exact endpoints and subnormal bracket; independent review edge fixed.
historical_validation.limitation: Prior manifest-reported validation, not newly executed at this revision or independently re-certified here. Relevant routine bytes were unchanged at the reviewed parent. These counts do not qualify new source hashes. Saved SciPy expectations are historical, even when comparison runs are fresh.
